notes.title: Bride for the Princess full release
notes.notes:
[h1]Our latest Visual Novel has left Early Access and is now a full release![/h1]

It'll have a special launch discount of -15% off the full price. We hope that you'll enjoy playing it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

[h2]We also have released Digital Artbook[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860

You may also get them together on a Special Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16263

notes.title: Important Linux update!
notes.notes:
Greetings Linux users! After long time and many trials, the file structure of Border of her Heart Linux version was totally changed including the deployement method. This huge update for Linux users should make the game playable if you used to have problems before.

Thank you from your patience and understanding, this took a lot of hard work and testing to get working. I hope you'll have fun playing Border of her Heart!

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31941310/5d9793ed5189cbab6236c007afcd68728433b4aa.png[/img]

[b]Achievements[/b]

[list][*]Game now features achievements[/list]

[b]Audio[/b]

[list][*]Missing narration during battle inside house has been added
[*]All the spoken dialogue has been enhanced and ran through various optimizations for better sound clarity and quality[/list]

[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Memory leak issues when loading game due to engine have been resolved
[*]Problems occuring from loading game due to engine have been resolved
[*]Problems with sliders due to engine have been resolved
[*]Declining cheating with Helewisa while having nightshift event occur caused Helewisa's sprite to remain on screen, this has been fixed[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Getting any of the endings now no longer exits the game but rather, boots you to the title screen[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Helewisa's position was off when going into date with her with HD DLC enabled, she's now positioned correctly[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]

[list][*]Numerous small performance tweaks[/list]

[b]Transitions[/b]

[list][*]Changed scene transition menthods to reduce load times when returning back to tent after each day[/list]
